title: Identification of variant-disease associations in Hereditary Breast and Ovarian Cancer by reanalysis of whole-genome sequencing data (HBOC-WGS -01)
summary: Despite routine gene panel testing, a significant proportion of individuals with suspected hereditary breast and ovarian cancer (HBOC) remain undiagnosed at the molecular level. This study utilizes comprehensive whole-genome sequencing (WGS) as part of the Model Project (MVH) and HerediCaRe to identify previously undetected hereditary causes and integrate polygenic risk scores (PRS) for more refined risk prediction. Ultimately, the systematic analysis of these genomic datasets aims to close the diagnostic gap, increase the overall diagnostic yield, and optimize personalized surveillance and prevention strategies for high-risk families.

interventions.name: Samples as well as genomic and clinical data are collected from the HerediCaRe registry. The patients underwent genetic testing as part of routine clinical care. Datasets from more than 500 patients are currently available.
